articles.title: How Amazon soy pact collapse could affect Brazil
articles.summary: A voluntary soy deforestation pact in Brazil, active for nearly 20 years, has collapsed. Researchers warn this could lead to over one million hectares of Amazon rainforest loss by 2036, releasing carbon emissions equivalent to Canada's annual output. The collapse is expected to accelerate deforestation, prompting calls for aggressive enforcement and stricter import demands to protect the Amazon.
articles.raw_summary: A voluntary soy deforestation pact has collapsed after nearly two decades of success. This collapse is predicted to cause significant future deforestation in the Amazon rainforest. Researchers estimate over one million hectares of forest loss by 2036. This deforestation will release substantial carbon emissions equivalent to Canada's annual output. Aggressive enforcement and stronger import demands are now recommended to protect the Amazon.

articles.title: A Supreme Court of Judicature functioned for over 60 years at Madras during British rule
articles.summary: During British rule, the legal system in Madras evolved through charters issued in 1687, 1798, and 1800. A 1687 charter established a court of record led by the Mayor and Aldermen, while later charters in 1798 and 1800 replaced this with the Court of the Recorder and eventually the Supreme Court of Judicature at Madras. These changes reflect the administrative and judicial developments in colonial India.
articles.raw_summary: A charter, issued in 1687, empowered the Mayor and three of the eldest Aldermen to form a court of record. King George III issued a charter in 1798 for constituting of the Court of the Recorder of Madras that replaced the Mayor’s Court. Yet another charter, issued in 1800, abolished this court and put in place the Supreme Court of Judicature at Madras

articles.title: A yo-yo monsoon is threatening India's crops and the power grid
articles.summary: India's monsoon rainfall is becoming more erratic due to El Niño and global warming, with the shift threatening agricultural output and straining the nation's power grids. articles.title: India's EXIM Bank plans $300 million dollar bond sale under RBI hedging facility
articles.summary: The Export-Import Bank of India plans to raise $300 million through dollar bonds. This move utilizes the central bank's subsidized hedging facility for overseas fundraising. articles.title: Global Market: German bond yields hit two-year high as oil surge fuels ECB rate hike bets
articles.summary: German bond yields rose to a two-year high as oil prices increased amid U.S.-Iran tensions. This surge strengthened expectations for the European Central Bank (ECB) to tighten monetary policy, with traders anticipating higher deposit rates by early 2027. Italy's 10-year bond yield also increased, widening the spread with German yields.

Italy's 10-year bond yield also increased, widening the spread with German yields.
